hypothesis.title: Zebra：重球动量在固定更新预算下相对参考 SGD 有准确率收益，且超过有效步长放大
hypothesis.statement: 在相同数据、相同 38 次更新、相同 batch 下，带动量 β=0.9 的 SGD（lr 0.005）在探索集上的准确率比参考 SGD（lr 0.005）高出超过 1.0 个百分点（C1），且该收益超过同更新预算下 lr 0.05 的 SGD（C2）。结论只限合成代理上的相对提升。

revisions.statement: 在相同数据、相同 38 次更新、相同 batch 下，带动量 β=0.9 的 SGD（lr 0.005）在探索集上的准确率比参考 SGD（lr 0.005）高出超过 1.0 个百分点（C1），且该收益超过同更新预算下 lr 0.05 的 SGD（C2）。结论只限合成代理上的相对提升。

named_risks: docs/project/min-setup.v1.md 用稳态 lr/(1−β)=0.05 设定匹配 SGD，但 38 步训练从零动量状态开始；SGD lr=0.05 与动量方法的实际更新轨迹未必匹配。
若 lr=0.05 的 SGD 不稳定或表现差，不能据此排除有效步长放大这一替代解释；若表现相当，也只支持该特定对照解释收益。
400 条评测样本中 1 个百分点等于 4 个样本；三个训练 seed 不增加评测样本数。仅以配对均值是否跨过 1.0 个百分点判定，可能对接近门槛的结果过度确定。
min-setup.v1.md 对动量相对参考方法和匹配对照的成功条件、以及动量与对照差距不超过 1.0 个百分点时的归因规则，尚未充分规定比较方向和边界结果如何裁决。
docs/literature/LIT-0001.v1.md 未核对原始文献；LIT-0002.v1.md 提供的是相邻而非直接匹配的证据，不能替代本项目的实测。
review_payload.cheapest_discriminating_experiment: 按 docs/project/min-setup.v1.md 在 explore 集上运行参考 SGD（lr=0.005）、动量（β=0.9，lr=0.005）和匹配 SGD（lr=0.05），使用共同训练 seed 42、43、44；逐 seed 报告三组准确率差值、seed 间 SD 及逐样本预测差异。实验前明确动量与匹配对照的比较口径。若出现值得追踪的信号，再按 protocol.v1.json 在 c1 上用 seed 1042–1044 独立确认。
missing_evidence: 三个方法在 38 次更新预算内的实际逐步更新或参数轨迹；目前没有证据表明稳态有效步长近似适用于该短程训练。
预先冻结的评测不确定性与边界结果处理规则，尤其是如何解释均值接近 1.0 个百分点以及动量和匹配 SGD 之间的小差异。
探索与独立确认阶段的实测结果；目前只有设计与判定门槛。

document.title: critical_review CAND-0002
document.summary: pi openai/gpt-6-luna: proceed

named_risks: CAND-0002 tests a learning-rate schedule, not the momentum-versus-effective-step-size question that docs/project/goal.v1.md defines as the bottom-line problem.

The candidate’s definition of “more stable” combines lower seed-to-seed SD with higher mean accuracy; these are distinct outcomes, while docs/project/metric-spec.v1.json makes accuracy the only metric and docs/project/min-setup.v2.md gates on mean paired accuracy.
A warmup ramp to 0.005 versus constant 0.005 tests the schedule at that target but not LIT-0006’s proposed mechanism that warmup permits a larger target learning rate.
On a 400-example evaluation set, 1 percentage point equals 4 examples; three training seeds may leave near-threshold effects unresolved.
LIT-0004 and LIT-0005 discuss settings unlike this small-batch logistic-regression proxy, limiting their support for the candidate’s expected effect.
review_payload.cheapest_discriminating_experiment: Run the planned warmup and constant-SGD conditions at the same 0.005 target on the same three training seeds, then report paired per-seed accuracy differences, mean, and SD; treat this as an exploratory schedule test. If the claim is that warmup permits a larger target rate, add one predeclared higher target rate with both warmup and constant schedules.
missing_evidence: Evidence that this candidate is in scope for the project’s momentum-focused bottom-line question, or an explicit scope change.
A single, prespecified success claim distinguishing reduced seed-to-seed SD from improved mean accuracy and specifying how it relates to the accuracy-only gate.
Results showing whether any effect is consistent across seeds and meaningfully exceeds the 1.0-percentage-point threshold.
A comparison at a higher shared target learning rate if the intended mechanism is that warmup permits a larger target rate.
Verification from implementation or run artifacts that warmup spans the intended first four updates and reaches the stated target rate.

document.title: critical_review CAND-0002
document.summary: pi openai/gpt-6-luna: proceed

named_risks: CAND-0002 修订 3 的余弦衰减不在 goal.v1.md 所限定的动量与有效步长底线问题内；将其结果解释为回答底线问题会造成范围错置。
候选以三 seed accuracy 的 SD 更小或均值更高作为“更稳”，混合了不同结果主张；SD 不在 metric-spec.v1.json 的唯一判定指标 accuracy 之内。
衰减终点允许为 0 或较小下限，且没有给出确切逐步调度定义，导致实验处理尚未完全冻结。
恒定 lr 0.005 对照不能区分余弦曲线本身、累计学习率暴露量与末端步长变化的作用。
400 条评测样本中 1.0 个百分点仅为 4 个样本，3 个训练 seed 对均值和 SD 的估计都很脆弱；门槛结果应谨慎解释。
现有 LIT-0004/0005/0006 与查新记录针对 warmup/修订 2，而非修订 3 的余弦衰减主张。
review_payload.cheapest_discriminating_experiment: 在完全冻结余弦调度公式与终点后，用相同训练代码、38 次更新、数据和三个配对训练 seed 比较余弦 lr 调度与恒定 lr 0.005；逐 seed 报告 accuracy 及配对差值均值、SD，并将均值提高与 SD 降低分别预先判定。若观察到差异，再加控制累计学习率暴露量的对照以区分调度形状机制。
missing_evidence: 修订 3 余弦调度的确切公式、终点及每一步学习率定义。
针对 cosine decay 而非 warmup 的相关文献与对应的查新评审。
与余弦候选相匹配的冻结协议、判定规则及独立确认计划。
在该 38 步逻辑回归设定下，三 seed accuracy 均值和离散度的实际结果；当前文件仅给出待检验声明。

items.note: 按简报所列工作逐项比较：Pan et al.（arXiv:2312.14567）与本候选同为重球动量，但其研究二次目标/岭回归、step decay、100 epochs，并进行学习率网格搜索；候选提出合成逻辑回归、恒定步长、38 次更新及学习率 0.05 的近似有效步长对照，构成有界且具体的设定差异。Polyak 1964 是方法来源，但文献记录称原文未取得，不能据此排除覆盖；Sutskever et al. 2013 在清单中仅据摘要，未显示覆盖该比较。更关键的是 E-0010-result.v2.md 记载 E-0011 匹配对照未运行，因此当前评估只支持动量相对参考 SGD 的结果，不支持把“超过有效步长放大”作为已由评估支持的当前主张。简报的文献清单有限，未能确认清单之外的相关先前工作是否已覆盖该精确比较。

document.title: candidate_recheck H-0001 theory
document.summary: pi openai/gpt-6-luna: fail

items.note: H-0001 hypothesis and blocks1-2-design require both A (momentum minus reference) and B (momentum minus matched SGD lr 0.05) >1.0 pp to support the claim that the gain exceeds effective-step amplification. E-0010 only supplies A: per-seed gains are 3.5, 8.75, and 1.75 pp (mean 4.67); E-0010-result.v2 explicitly says E-0011 matched control was not run. Thus the observed reference-relative gain cannot establish momentum-specific benefit. The 38-update comparison is expressly only an approximate steady-state match, not stepwise equivalence. Three same-direction paired differences are a screening signal, not broad evidence; the result reports their values but not their SD, while min-setup says report SD and notes 1 pp equals 4/400 evaluation examples and seed variability is the main paired-difference noise. Claim must remain limited to the synthetic proxy and exploratory evaluation; that scope is consistent with the design, but does not cure the unresolved attribution.

Current evidence supports only a limited exploratory proxy-relative difference; it does not establish mechanism, robust generalization, or confirmation.
